description: Phase C — Normal continuation: Loop clip with sectionBehavior=Normal keeps cycling past the break. 16-frame PNG sequence (30fps source, 30fps timeline) extended to 200 timeline frames; section break at timeline frame 8. With Locked, the timeline-derived path would freeze the source frame at 8 (timeline frame 8 / 30fps * 30fps = source 8). With Normal+Loop, SectionScheduler seeds ClipPlaybackPhase=8 and advances it through the at-break park, so the source phase drifts away from 8 -- mediaFrame leaves the [8±2] window. This is the differentiator vs. section_locked_clip.json, which asserts the same setup with sectionBehavior=Locked stays at 8. CI-robustness notes: WaitUntilPlaybackState replaces the fixed WaitSeconds-then-assert (the park happens whenever the slow runner actually reaches frame 8, not on a stopwatch), and WaitUntilClipMediaFrame polls until the phase has demonstrably drifted -- a Locked-style freeze regression parks at exactly 8 forever and fails the timeout.
